'''Tis Dolan''' was a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the ''de facto'' leader of the [[Anjiliac]] clan operations on the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Point Nadir]].

==Biography==
An ambitious [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Tis Dolan fled her enemies on [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]] to make a name for herself. She briefly worked with a group of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] thieves, but her opportunity came when she met [[Zietta Anjiliac]] in the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Point Nadir]]. Zietta was incompetent compared to other [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and was a disgrace of her [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. Dolan decided to make her place in Point Nadir hierarchy through Zietta, and for that she gained Zietta's confidence, even though she despised her. Then she used her last money to engineer the assassination of Zietta's cousin, [[Tirello Anjiliac]], the boss of Point Nadir. Then, Dolan organized Zietta's rise to power, helping her establish control of the Point Nadir. In truth, Zietta remained nothing but a puppet in hands of Tis Dolan, who made the majority of the decisions and manipulated the Hutt to her own ends, fighting to maintain that position.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

==Personality and traits==
Tis was a petite Wroonian who wore sharp business attire. She was terse and to the point, and could be vindictive that would border on obsession. She had [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin, violet [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and blue-black hair that she wore braided into a queue. She could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Bothese]], [[Cerean (language)|Cerean]], [[Durese/Legends|Durese]], [[Houkese]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]], and [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustese]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

==Talents and Abilities==
An accomplished combatant, Dolan was known to possess exceptional [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] and gun skills.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
